newsitem.title: USA: Unocal says 76 Products sold at about $2 bln.
newsitem.headline: Unocal says 76 Products sold at about $2 bln.

text.p: Unocal Corp said Monday that it valued the sale of its 76 Products Co unit to Tosco Corp at approximately $2 billion.

The fixed refining, marketing and transportation assets go for $1.4 billion and Unocal said it is expecting approximately $400 million for inventories. Also, the transaction stipulates an additional payment by Tosco of up to $250 million in participation payments should gasoline margins on the West Coast increase in the next seven years.
In addition, Unocal will liquidate $80 million in net receivables, which will not be part of this transaction.
